SELECT s.store_id, s.format, f.channel_code, f.staff_purchase_flag,
 count(*) lines, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dist_lines, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) receipts,
 sum(f.net_amount) net, sum(CASE WHEN f.net_amount<=0 OR f.quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos,

GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,3,4

calls.statement:
WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.*, s.store_id, s.format FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND f.channel_id=1 AND s.store_id<900),
r AS (SELECT receipt_id, count(DISTINCT store_id) n_st, count(DISTINCT sale_date) n_d, count(DISTINCT staff_purchase_flag) n_sf FROM l GROUP BY 1)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM r WHERE n_st>1) multi_store, (SELECT count(*) FROM r WHERE n_d>1) multi_date, (SELECT count(*) FROM r WHERE n_sf>1) mixed_staff,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM l WHERE store_id=999) training,
 (SELECT min(etl_loaded_at)||' / '||max(etl_loaded_at) FROM l) etl,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM l WHERE sale_date NOT IN (SELECT calendar_date FROM dim_date WHERE is_trading_day)) nontrading_lines,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_sales_line_load WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30') stg_lines,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_sales_line_load s WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND sales_line_id IN (SELECT sales_line_id FROM l)) stg_overlap

calls.statement:
SELECT s.format AS store_format,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.receipt_id END) AS transactions,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN NOT f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount END),2) AS net_sales,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN NOT f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount END) / count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.receipt_id END),2) AS atv_excl_staff,
 round(sum(f.net_amount)/count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id),2) AS atv_incl_staff
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
  AND f.channel_id = 1 AND s.store_id < 900
GROUP BY s.format ORDER BY CASE s.format WHEN 'Small' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
